name: EIE Requested Items To Be Manufacture
query:
select 
	mr.name as "Material Request:Link/Material Request:180",
	mr.transaction_date as "Date:Date:100",
	mr_item.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item:250",
	mr_item.item_name as "Item Name:Data:250",
	sum(ifnull(mr_item.qty, 0)) as "Qty:Float:100",
	sum(ifnull(mr_item.ordered_qty, 0)) as "Manufactured Qty:Float:150", 
	(sum(mr_item.qty) - sum(ifnull(mr_item.ordered_qty, 0))) as "Qty to Manufacture:Float:150",
	usr.full_name as "Production Manager:Data:200",
	mr.company as "Company:Link/Company:200"

from `tabMaterial Request` mr join `tabMaterial Request Item` mr_item left join `tabItem` im
ON mr_item.item_code = im.item_code
left join `tabUser` usr
ON im.production_manager = usr.name

where
	mr_item.parent = mr.name
	and mr.material_request_type = "Manufacture"
	and mr.docstatus = 1
	and mr.status != "Stopped"
group by mr.name, mr_item.item_code
having
    (SUM(mr_item.qty) - SUM(IFNULL(mr_item.ordered_qty, 0))) > 0
order by mr.transaction_date asc
report_name: EIE Requested Items To Be Manufacture
